products.name: Gulmohar Rose-Gold Embroidered Anarkali Set
products.description: An ethereal floor-length Anarkali kurti crafted from gossamer Chanderi silk with delicate rose-gold gota patti and zardozi embroidery along the yoke, sleeve cuffs, and grand hem flare. Includes matching modal churidar and hand-embroidered organza dupatta.

products.name: Parijat Sage Mint Straight-Cut Silk Kurti
products.description: Crisp, tailored straight-cut silhouette adorned with fine resham threadwork and mirror accents framing the split V-neckline. Features side slits and paired matching straight silk cigarette trousers for minimal modern royalty.

details.washCare: Gentle Hand Wash or Dry Clean

products.name: Noorani Wine Silk Flared Festive Anarkali
products.description: A showstopper festive ensemble in a rich wine red palette, embellished with hand-embroidered sequin flowers, broad antique zari borders, and a magnificent 4-meter flare. Accompanied by a sheer golden dupatta.

products.name: Lilac Whisper Embroidered Pret Co-ord Set
products.description: Understated luxury meets everyday ease. Features a hip-length modern tunic kurti with subtle cutwork embroidery on the yoke and cuffs, paired with tailored ankle-length trousers with comfortable elasticated waistband.

products.name: Chandni Handloom Cotton Short Kurti
products.description: Contemporary short kurti featuring delicate pintuck detailing and wooden button accents down the center placket. Versatile styling piece suitable for university, work desk, or brunch outings with friends.

products.name: Kashmiri Tilla A-Line Long Kurti
products.description: Dramatic long-line silhouette inspired by Kashmiri heritage needlework. Graceful A-line flare with side slits that move effortlessly as you walk. Comes with an attached butter crepe lining.

products.name: Sanganeri Handblock Floral Printed Kurti
products.description: Authentic handcrafted Jaipur Sanganeri block print on pure organic cotton. Gentle round neckline framed with potli buttons and contrast piping. Breathable fabric that softens with every wash.

products.name: Zahra Festive 3-Piece Silk Kurti Set with Dupatta
products.description: Complete 3-piece regal celebration set consisting of an embroidered calf-length straight kurti, matching wide-leg silk palazzos, and a luminous metallic tissue dupatta with hand-knotted tassels.

details.neckline: Boat Neck with Gold Zari Resham

products.name: Banarasi Zari Handwoven Silk Dupatta
products.fabric: Katan Silk with Pure Gold Zari Weave
products.description: Handcrafted Banarasi heritage dupatta featuring intricate floral kadwa weaves and grand pallu borders. Elevates any solid kurti or suit instantly with timeless royal elegance.

details.pattern: Banarasi Floral Kadwa Weave & Zari Pallu

products.name: Breeze Cotton Mulmul Tunic with Lace Trims
products.description: Chic fusion tunic tailored with delicate schiffli lace inserts along the sleeve hems and neckline. High-low hemline offers contemporary styling over trousers or denim jeans.

details.pattern: Solid Textured Mulmul with Schiffli Detailing

faqItems.question: How do I choose the right size?
faqItems.answer: Use our Women Size Guide or Smart Fit Finder on any product page. Our kurtis allow a 2-inch tailoring margin for comfortable drape.

faqItems.question: How do returns and size exchanges work?
faqItems.answer: Eligible unworn items with tags intact can be requested for return or size exchange within 7 days of delivery through Track Order.

faqItems.question: How can boutiques place wholesale orders?
faqItems.answer: Open the Wholesale B2B Portal to submit your business details for approval, or call +91 9310078735 directly.
